name: Headscale
author: juanfont
description: Open-source, self-hosted implementation of the Tailscale control server. Official Tailscale clients join your own tailnet with --login-server; no Tailscale account needed.

form_fields.label: MagicDNS base domain
form_fields.hint: Suffix for node names (node.ts.internal). Must not be the domain headscale itself is served on.

form_fields.label: DERP map URL
form_fields.hint: Relay servers. The default uses Tailscale's public DERP relays (no account; traffic stays end-to-end encrypted).
